description: Help of the --session flag of bridge
other: session name (scopes the orchestrator/attachment dir)

description: Help of the --project flag of bridge
other: project name, the shared memory scope (P1: every agent of this game recalls it)

description: Help of the --agent flag of bridge
other: agent name, the private memory scope (P1: this agent's learned skills)

description: Help of the --project-pinned flag of bridge
other: the memory project was chosen by a human, not guessed from a directory: never revise it

description: Help of the -v flag of bridge
other: log activity to stderr

description: Help of the --hub-socket flag of bridge
other: unix socket of the daemon hub: when set, run as a pure backend runner (no gateway polling)

description: Help of the --agents-root flag of bridge
other: directory holding agent homes for the delegation roster (empty = the daemon default beside state.json)

description: Help of the --extractor flag of bridge
other: name of a registered curation extractor. It enables the P1 learning loop (empty = plain Curator, no learning)

description: Help of the --journal flag of bridge
other: path to the call journal Consolidate reads (worktree-relative ok); only used with --extractor

description: Help of the --consolidate-every flag of bridge
other: run Consolidate every N turns (0 = manual only); only used with --extractor

description: Help of the --state flag of bridge
other: path to the daemon state file whose model cache the bridge reads (empty = the default state file)

description: Help of the --env-stdin flag of bridge
other: read KEY=VALUE lines from stdin until a blank line and put them in this process's environment (how a remote bridge gets its gateway credentials)

description: Help of the --cmd flag of bridge
other: base command (default 'claude' in stream mode; the per-message program in one-shot mode)

description: Help of the --backend flag of bridge
other: responder backend: stream (default) | oneshot

description: Help of the --vendor flag of bridge
other: backend vendor: claude | codex | cursor (empty = first registered / HERRSCHER_BACKEND)

description: Help of the --resume flag of bridge
other: backend resume token to resume the conversation on start

description: Help of the --model flag of bridge
other: catalog model id (see `herrscher models list`); empty = legacy path, the model rides in --cmd

description: Help of the --account flag of bridge
other: account profile of the vendor login (see `herrscher account list`); empty = the vendor default, native = the machine login

description: Help of the deprecated --stream flag of bridge
other: deprecated, ignored (accepted for backward compatibility)
